changelog: Adds optional torrent source streaming. When a title is not in your library, the app can now find streamable sources and start playing one immediately, streaming it while it downloads rather than waiting for a download to finish. Nothing is imported into your library. Sources are found through Prowlarr, ranked server-side for the best chance of playing smoothly rather than the largest file, and served to the player over ordinary HTTP with range requests so seeking works. Audio and subtitle tracks are read from the file with ffprobe so track selection behaves the same as it does for library media. Off by default: enable it under Source streaming in the plugin settings and set a Prowlarr URL and API key. Note that peer traffic originates from this server's IP address.
